cases.sentence: Иоав, сын Саруи, и люди Давида вышли и встретили их у ___.
cases.explain: «гаваонского пруда» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

cases.explain: «дикая серна» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

cases.sentence: Тогда Авнер пронзил ему в живот ___ своего копья, так, что оно вышло наружу у него через спину.
cases.explain: «обратным концом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: However he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
